species: A Multiregional Proteomic Survey of the Postnatal Human Brain
tissue: Of the 16 regions profiled in BrainSpan, 7 regions that showed large inter-regional differences in gene expression by RNA-seq were selected: cerebellum (CBC), striatum (STR), mediodorsal thalamic nucleus (MD), amygdala (AMY), hippocampus (HIP), primary visual cortex (V1C), and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DFC).
disease_state: A Multiregional Proteomic Survey of the Postnatal Human Brain
sample_source: This study was conducted using frozen post-mortem human brain specimens from a number of tissue collections facilitated by the Brainspan and psychENCODE consortia
age: one year post conception to 42 years
Single shot, label-free protein quantifications (LFQs) were obtained from the seven brain regions of 16 individuals spanning one year post conception to 42 years.
sex: Developmental samples spanned the period from early infancy (1 year post conception) to adulthood (42 years), and were derived from a near equal mix of male and female donors (Fig 1A; Table S1).
